name: Gabriel
abilities: Axiom: Ophanim Throne Judgment Oath of Intercept
passives: Choir Edict: Axiom gains Choir Resonance when guardian play intercepts a declared threat and stores the impact as later utility on ordered sigil zones. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a radiant hierarchy judgment rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Radiant Hierarchies.
lore: Gabriel, Herald of the Final Bell, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Empyrean. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: divine messenger, warning trumpet, command intervention, guardian of announced fate. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses divine messenger, warning trumpet, command intervention, guardian of announced fate; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Empyrean canon.
visualDescription: Gabriel manifests as divine messenger, warning trumpet, command intervention, guardian of announced fate from Empyrean: noble masculine herald face, clear eyes, straight nose, composed mouth, youthful authority; slender athletic masculine messenger build, long limbs, lifted chest, fast intercept stance; signature silhouette: trumpet spear, folded wings, messenger tabard, bell aura. Weapon: long silver trumpet-spear and bell-metal buckler. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Axiom — Seraph Edict Lash Intercept
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Empyrean source-culture damage at range 1; generate Momentum and a small Choir Resonance gain when used from edict-sung holy geometry or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Choir Seal Technique — Punishing Guard
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to intercepts lethal paths, counters oathbreakers/trespassers, and turns defense into threat. Builds Choir Resonance only when the player uses edict-sung holy geometry intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Axiom: Ophanim Throne Judgment Oath of Intercept
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Choir Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Radiant Hierarchies: intercepts lethal paths, counters oathbreakers/trespassers, and turns defense into threat. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Seraphic Choir Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Choir Resonance, transform nearby terrain into edict-sung holy geometry, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Axiom Sentinel Seraph Bell-Edict Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through edict-sung holy geometry. Visual: white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Axiom Opal-Glass Cherubim Aegis
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Radiant Hierarchies source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Axiom Ophanim Many-Eye Choir Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Choir Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Archangel Herald Ascent, Ophanim Wheel Intercept, and Seal the Discord. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: counter bosses and protect survival windows
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Axiom's Choir Edict: a solo mechanic where Choir Resonance grows through ordered sigil zones, reaction-window mastery, and guardian decisions that intercept a declared threat and store the impact as later utility. Payoff: protect mission objects or civilians while still acting solo. Counterplay: multi-timing attacks and feints pull the guard out of position; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: multi-timing attacks and feints pull the guard out of position
